name: Conventional Commit Draft
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
tip: Select only the commit subjects of one release before you run the preview. Other text in the note stays out of the draft.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Conventional Commit Draft is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to draft your release notes.
